name: Alexander I of Macedon
role: King of Macedon from c. 498/497 to 454 BC
contribution: King of the ancient kingdom of Macedonia from 498/497 BC until his death in 454 BC.

checks.lead: Alexander I (Ancient Greek: Ἀλέξανδρος, romanized: Alexandros; died 454 BC), also known as Alexander the Philhellene (Ancient Greek: φιλέλλην; lit. 'Supporter of Greece' or 'Greek/Hellene patriot' ), was king of the ancient kingdom of Macedonia from 498/497 BC until his death in 454 BC. He was succeeded by his eldest son, Perdiccas II.
